controls.name: Check engine light on
controls.notes: CPID $01 bank 1, bit $80 (mask + value). Off gives the lamp back to the PCM. Found on a 2001 3.8L PCM (OS 9389759); watch PID $1104 bit 0.

controls.name: Check engine light off
controls.notes: Forces the MIL off while active (mask $80, value 0). Checked on the bench: PID $1104 bit 0 goes to 0 and back when released.

controls.name: Change oil light on
controls.notes: CPID $01 bank 1, bit $20. Checked on the bench: PID $1104 bit 4 follows.

controls.name: Low oil light on
controls.notes: CPID $01 bank 1, bit $10 (PID $1104 bit 2). On the bench the lamp was already on; forcing it off (10 00) was checked.

controls.name: Generator (battery) light on
controls.notes: CPID $01 bank 1, bit $08 (PID $1104 bit 3). On the bench the lamp was already on; forcing it off (08 00) was checked.

controls.name: Engine hot light on
controls.notes: CPID $01 bank 1, bit $04 (PID $1104 bit 1). On the bench the lamp was already on; forcing it off (04 00) was checked.

controls.name: Cooling fan 1 on
controls.confirm: Run cooling fan 1? Keep hands clear of the fan.
controls.notes: CPID $01 bank 2, bit $80. Checked on the bench: PID $1103 bit 6 (fan 1 command) follows.

controls.name: EVAP vent solenoid on
controls.notes: CPID $01 bank 2, bit $08. Checked on the bench: PID $1107 bit 2 follows.

controls.name: Reset long-term fuel trims
controls.confirm: Reset the long-term fuel trims the PCM has learned?
controls.notes: CPID $02, reset bit $40 (from the original UVSCAN). The PCM accepts it; the trims relearn while driving.
